title: Application of composed maps
statement: For polynomial-time maps $F,G$ on Boolean lists and any Boolean list $x$, the composition $G\circ F$ sends $x$ to $G(F(x))$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ and $G$ are polynomial-time maps on Boolean lists
